newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - HUHTAMAKI 8-MTH PROFIT SEEN UP.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - HUHTAMAKI 8-MTH PROFIT SEEN UP.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 270 million markka median
forecast for confectionery and packaging materials group
Huhtamaki Oy's January-August profit after financial items,
before extraordinaries.
Profit after financial items
(FIM million)
Median 270
Mean 267
Lowest 222
Highest 314
The results are due on October 11 at 0900/0600 GMT.
In January-August 1995, Huhtamaki posted a 201 million
markka profit.
For Huhtamaki's full-year 1996 profit, nine of the 12
analysts polled gave a median forecast profit after financial
items, before extraordinaries of 416 million markka (mean 421
million) in a 350-493 million markka range.
On June 12, Huhtamaki said it expected its full-year 1996
profit to improve on 1995. The 1995 profit after financial items
was 312 million markka.
The data was collected in the first two weeks of October.
Contributors to the survey were Aros Securities, AG Private
Bankers, Aktia Bank, Alfred Berg, Carnegie, Erik Selin, Evli
Securities, FSB, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita and Opstock.
